title: Moonlit Elven Portrait print
story: A Logan Square client commissioned a custom wall print for the wall above their bed and chose the Moonlit Elven Portrait, an original high-fantasy piece with luminous forest detail and silver ceremonial styling. We printed it at 45 by 90 cm on a satin stock that lifts the moonlit highlights without adding glare from the bedside lamps. A calm, personal piece that shows the range of what we can put on a Chicago wall.

photos.alt: Moonlit elven portrait wall print with luminous forest detail and silver styling, installed above a bed
